children: BioCardia regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid-price requirement after 10 consecutive business days at or above $1.00.
Nasdaq notified BioCardia that its closing bid price met the $1.00 minimum for at least 10 consecutive business days.
The compliance determination closes the prior matter related to a 30-day deficiency under Nasdaq Rule 5550(a)(2).
Trading of BioCardia common stock continues on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol BCDA without interruption.
Company notes no assurance it will maintain compliance with the minimum bid-price requirement in the future.
